name: @pipeworx/mcp-httpcat

tools.name: get_status_cat
tools.description: Get a cat image representing an HTTP status code. Provide the code (e.g., 200, 404, 500). Returns the image URL.

tools.name: list_codes
tools.description: Browse all available HTTP status codes with descriptions and cat image URLs. Use to find the right code for your status or explore available options.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-httpcat forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the httpcat pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
